steps.text: Go down the drain in the south-west corner of Edron castle.
steps.source: From the Edron depot, go down the drain in the south-west corner of the castle (Mapper Coords 129.141, 124.84, 7).

steps.text: There is only one way: follow the cave (rats) down and up with your rope until you come out in a grassy area.
steps.source: There is only one way to go, so follow the cave until you emerge in a grassy area (Mapper Coords 129.105, 124.67, 7).

steps.text: Go south-west over the goblin hill and down the hole (up to 10 goblins).
steps.source: Go south-west until you find the goblin hill (Mapper Coords 129.83, 124.104, 7). Go down the hole, and be prepared to face up to 10 Goblins at once.

steps.text: Go north-west and down the next hole (goblins).
steps.source: Follow this path to the north-west and go down the hole.

steps.text: Go to the hole in the far north-east corner and down (goblins).
steps.source: Follow this path to the hole in the far north-east corner. Go down this hole.

steps.text: In the throne room to the north (goblins, 2 wasps): the box with a silver amulet.
steps.source: The reward is in two chests in the throne room to the north. Watch out for more goblins and 2 wasps.

steps.text: And the box with a steel shield.
steps.source: The reward is in two chests in the throne room to the north.
